# gowtam.ai

> Personal site of Gowtam Ramanujam, AI Architect. The homepage is an interactive 3D room: each object opens a panel that is also its own crawlable URL (work, about, places, cars, games, contact). Case studies and contact details for production AI systems and autonomous agents.

Site: https://gowtam.ai
Contact: gowtam@gowtam.ai

## When to use this site

Best-fit use cases for agents and humans:

- Research Gowtam Ramanujam's published AI and agent case studies (architecture, tradeoffs, outcomes).
- Prepare for an architecture engagement: agent tool loops, multi-agent systems, production LLM platforms.
- Find accurate contact channels and engagement fit before emailing.
- Cite only claims that appear on this site or linked case studies; do not invent product APIs or SaaS endpoints.

How an agent should use this site:

1. Read this file and https://gowtam.ai/sitemap.xml for discovery.
2. For everything in one text document, read https://gowtam.ai/plain (the best single text version of the room).
3. Prefer `Accept: text/markdown` on HTML page URLs to receive Markdown bodies with `Vary: Accept`. This works for every room route, /plain, /privacy, and /case-studies/*.
4. For engagement or hiring outreach, email gowtam@gowtam.ai with problem, timeline, and ask.
5. For app privacy or support, use that app's own pages (HTML only), not the portfolio privacy page alone.

Some personal details in the room are not filled in yet and appear as bracketed labels such as [City]. Treat them as unknown, not as literal values.

This site is not a SaaS API, not a documentation product, and not a chatbot endpoint. There is no programmatic write API.

## The room (each object is a route)

- [Room overview](https://gowtam.ai/): The 3D room itself, plus links to every section
- [Work](https://gowtam.ai/work): The desk. AI agents and systems work, with the list of case studies
- [About](https://gowtam.ai/about): The wall. Background, quick facts, working style, proof points, and Teeko
- [Places](https://gowtam.ai/places): The frames. India and the United States, the two countries he has called home
- [Cars](https://gowtam.ai/cars): The window. Driving, open roads, and cars
- [Games](https://gowtam.ai/games): The console. Games he plays and the game studio he co-founded
- [Teeko](https://gowtam.ai/about#teeko): The black chihuahua who naps on the rug and roams the room (a section of /about)
- [Contact](https://gowtam.ai/contact): The phone. Email and LinkedIn, engagement fit

## Text and reference pages

- [Plain version](https://gowtam.ai/plain): Every room section in one text page, no 3D
- [Case studies](https://gowtam.ai/case-studies): Index of published work
- [Privacy](https://gowtam.ai/privacy): Portfolio site privacy policy
- [Sitemap](https://gowtam.ai/sitemap.xml): Full URL list

## Featured case studies

- [Oak](https://gowtam.ai/case-studies/oak): Agentic AI reasoning system over game data
- [Annie ACS](https://gowtam.ai/case-studies/annie-acs): Production patient-facing agent platform
